about: Sourced materials catalogue. Every number was read in the cited document and converted to SI; properties a source does not give are absent (listed under coverage.missing) and are never filled in here. Strengths of metals are handbook design values on the stated basis, repeated under Sy/Su because the handbook gives no typical values. Regenerate with `node tools/build-materials.mjs`.

sources.title: MIL-HDBK-5J, Metallic Materials and Elements for Aerospace Vehicle Structures
sources.licence_note: Work of the United States Government, Distribution Statement A (approved for public release; distribution is unlimited): not subject to copyright in the United States. Superseded by MMPDS for certification use.

sources.title: MIL-HDBK-17-2F, Composite Materials Handbook, Volume 2: Polymer Matrix Composites, Materials Properties
sources.licence_note: Work of the United States Government, Distribution Statement A: not subject to copyright in the United States. Superseded by CMH-17.

sources.title: MIL-C-7438G, Core Material, Aluminum, for Sandwich Construction
sources.licence_note: Work of the United States Government, Distribution Statement A. Cancelled specification (SAE AMS-C-7438 is the suggested replacement); its tables state that the values are for test purposes only.

sources.title: DOT/FAA/AR-05/15, Fatigue Crack Growth Database for Damage Tolerance Analysis
sources.org: US Federal Aviation Administration (Forman, Shivakumar, Cardinal, Williams, McKeighan)
sources.licence_note: Technical report published by the FAA and available to the US public through NTIS; prepared under contract, so individual values are recorded as cited facts and no text is reproduced.

sources.title: UCRL-ID-134691, Experimental Investigations of Material Models for Ti-6Al-4V and 2024-T3 (also issued as DOT/FAA/AR-00/25)
sources.org: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (D. R. Lesuer) for the FAA
sources.licence_note: US Department of Energy laboratory report prepared for the FAA, publicly released; individual values recorded as cited facts, no text reproduced.

sources.title: NASA/TM-2011-217059, Alternative Aviation Fuel Experiment (AAFEX)
sources.org: NASA Langley Research Center (Anderson et al.)
sources.licence_note: NASA Technical Memorandum on the NASA Technical Reports Server, public use permitted; work of the United States Government.

sources.title: NASA/TM-2010-216838, Mode II Interlaminar Fracture Toughness and Fatigue Characterization of a Graphite Epoxy Composite Material
sources.org: NASA Langley Research Center (O'Brien, Johnston, Toland)
sources.licence_note: NASA Technical Memorandum on the NASA Technical Reports Server, public use permitted.

sources.title: Comparison of Intralaminar and Interlaminar Mode-I Fracture Toughness of Unidirectional IM7/8552 Graphite/Epoxy Composite
sources.licence_note: Conference paper released on the NASA Technical Reports Server; individual values recorded as cited facts, no text reproduced.

sources.title: NCP-RP-2009-028 Rev B, Hexcel 8552 IM7 Unidirectional Prepreg 190 gsm & 35%RC Qualification Statistical Analysis Report
sources.org: National Center for Advanced Materials Performance (NCAMP), Wichita State University
sources.licence_note: Published by NCAMP with Distribution Statement A (approved for public release); not a US Government work, so individual values are recorded as cited facts and no text is reproduced.

sources.title: Product Data Sheet, Model INR-21700-P42A
sources.licence_note: Manufacturer datasheet cited by link; individual values recorded as facts, no text reproduced. The datasheet says its figures are for reference only.
